dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like a lot of trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: I'm a bit of a clean freak as well, so just thinking about cleaning these things is making me nauseous.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: If only Noelle from the Knights was here. If she were here, all this would be spick and span in no time — even better than new!

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Still, I feel bad about troubling her to do something this trivial...
